summary: Encode ignores checkLength param; always writes 1 check digit regardless of caller request
failure_scenario: Caller passes checkLength=2 expecting 2-digit checksum; only 1 written, verification fails or digest diverges from spec

summary: RarityOf uses wrong mapping: (0,0)=Genesis instead of height==1&&era==0, omits Solstice/Eraborn tiers entirely
failure_scenario: First seed at height 1 era 0 misclassified; Solstice/Eraborn seeds fall to Common, breaking rarity economics

summary: RAM guard inverted: aborts when workingSet > threshold instead of when < threshold (needs RAM to run)
failure_scenario: System with 3 GB RAM (below 4 GB threshold) allowed to load model; 8 GB system wrongly blocked, preventing on-device inference

summary: StoredBlock.Stage settable (set not init) and HashOf uses mutable Stage in hash; block can change stage after hashing, invalidating verification
failure_scenario: Block staged to dew, hashed, then Stage changed to gathered; HashOf() now returns different value, breaking Merkle proofs and claim verification

summary: Duplicate ScreenId enum definition conflicts with AppModel.cs (same namespace Slumberbloom.UI)
failure_scenario: C# compiler rejects duplicate enum ScreenId in same namespace; build fails unless one file excluded; UI references ambiguous

summary: Double.ToString("R") can emit scientific notation (e.g. 1E-06) which JS never emits for fractions; comment says trim but no trim applied
failure_scenario: Canonical JSON for very small/large fractions differs from web version that trims exponent, causing hash mismatches
